justification: Inspected javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/nodeTypes/NodeWithTypeParameters.java and found a small, focused interface with only four direct dependencies/imports (Node, NodeList, TypeParameter, and parseTypeParameter). Repository search showed only 6 direct AST implementers in javaparser-core (CallableDeclaration, ClassOrInterfaceDeclaration, MethodDeclaration, ConstructorDeclaration, CompactConstructorDeclaration, RecordDeclaration) and 4 non-implementing clients in javaparser-core/javaparser-symbol-solver-core (Java1_0Validator, JavaParserTypeDeclarationAdapter, JavaParserTypeAdapter, AbstractMethodLikeDeclarationContext). That is shared, but not high fan-in/fan-out enough to qualify as a hub-like modularization smell.
